attribution.title: Zaal 100, De Wittenstraat 100, Amsterdam: music and theatre venue in a brick building of 1892
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for roofs, side and back walls (CC BY 4.0): the 38 m salmon-buff brick front in five bays between lesenes with segment-headed window triplets, light stone courses and arch rings, the cornice with white consoles, four hooded dormers, the crested middle gable, and the venue's black 1 0 0 windows, sign band and vertical sign. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
